name: onesano S.A.
summary: Established in 1995 and based in Chorzów, Poland, onesano S.A. specializes in research and development within Poland, particularly in dietetics, animal nutrition, bioremediation, and agrotechnological processes. The company provides a range of human dietary supplements, notably under its Estrovita brand. Additionally, it offers animal health products such as Yarrowia Equinox, Yarrowia Canifelox, and Yarrowia Farminox. Its broader product portfolio encompasses various dietary supplements, food additives, functional foods, and raw materials for cosmetic use. onesano distributes its offerings through a comprehensive network including chain pharmacies, pharmaceutical wholesalers, organic/health food stores, drugstores, e-commerce platforms, zoological outlets, veterinary clinics, zoological and veterinary wholesalers, as well as directly to producers of animal feed and supplementary mixtures and contract manufacturers. The company, previously known as Skotan SA, officially adopted the name onesano S.A. in March 2023.
